newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks extend gains ahead of close.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks extend gains ahead of close.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks rallied ahead of the close on Friday, but on thin volume, with the Hang Seng Index extending the session's gains to trade 155 points, or 1.29 percent, higher at 12,210.
Brokers said activity in the futures market was driving the Hang Seng Index higher. The April contract was up 160 points at 12,170.
"The spot index does not have a clear direction so the futures activity is affecting the market's performance," said one broker.
Conglomerates were the best performing stocks. Hutchison rose HK$1.25 to HK$55.25 and Wharf gained HK$0.85 to HK$29.60.
